chars.M: MOHAMED: a man in his early thirties wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.S: SOUAD: a young woman wearing a lilac hijab and a long dusty-pink dress with a small beige crossbody bag.
chars.O: THE OTHER WOMAN: a flashy woman wearing a red headscarf tied back fashionably, big gold hoop earrings, a tight red leather jacket and black trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, living room of a modest Moroccan apartment in Meknes with a patterned sedari sofa and zellige details. MOHAMED, grinning sneakily, sprays cologne on his neck and tiptoes toward the front door while hiding his glowing phone behind his back; SOUAD stands right behind him with arms crossed, glaring at him with hurt, suspicious eyes. Open tension between the two, slightly comic.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment dining area in the evening. SOUAD sits alone at a small round table with a tajine and two plates, looking sad and patient; in the background MOHAMED lies on the sofa laughing at his phone, completely ignoring her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan kitchen. SOUAD quietly wipes a tear while washing dishes, her back half turned; MOHAMED stands in the kitchen doorway with his hand on the back of his neck, looking guilty and ashamed.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Front door of the Moroccan apartment in daytime. SOUAD, upset, stands at the open door holding a small travel bag, pointing back at MOHAMED and saying she is going to her mother's; MOHAMED shrugs on the sofa, pretending not to care.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan apartment entrance. MOHAMED nervously looks left and right in the stairwell while pulling THE OTHER WOMAN inside by the hand; she smiles confidently, he holds a finger to his lips. Sneaky and awkward, slightly comic.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A traditional Moroccan family house living room with an older patterned sofa. SOUAD sits on the sofa holding her phone to her ear, calling, with a polite routine expression; a cup of mint tea on the low table in front of her.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell of a Moroccan apartment building in the afternoon. SOUAD climbs the stairs early, holding her keys in one hand and her travel bag in the other, with a determined, suspicious look, her phone put away in her bag.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the apartment hallway. SOUAD gently pushes the front door open and tiptoes in very quietly, holding her breath, eyes wide with suspicion, looking toward a closed bedroom door at the end of the hallway; a pair of red women's high heels lies on the floor near the door.
